# Halucinate

> Halucinate designs and delivers advanced VR attractions, immersive entertainment systems, automated kiosks, physical experiences and custom event activations for malls, entertainment centres, businesses and destinations across India.

## What Halucinate builds

- Multiplayer Free Roam VR — wireless multi-player virtual gaming arenas for gaming centres, malls, resorts and family entertainment centres.
- Single-Player VR Games — compact VR attractions including VR cricket, VR shooting, racing simulators and horror experiences, suited to Tier 2 cities and smaller venues.
- AI Photo Booth — fully automated AI portrait and photo-strip kiosk for malls, events and tourist destinations.
- Physical Escape Rooms — complete themed escape rooms with electronic puzzles, sensors and automated control systems.
- Digital Scary House — projection-mapped walkthrough horror attraction with physical effects and interactive puzzles.
- Self-Service Massage Chair Kiosk — unattended QR-payment massage chair kiosk for cinemas, malls, airports and corporate spaces.
- Custom Event Activations — technology-based branded activations for corporate events, exhibitions, festivals and mall promotions.
- Super Reality 360 Dome — large-format panoramic projection dome for shared immersive shows.
- Immersive Room — multi-wall projection environment for gaming, education, storytelling and brand experiences.
